l1a_sahai.claim: Pandit Sanju Sahai, tabla solo in drut (fast) tintal, Darbar Festival
l1a_sahai.ask: Confirm: is this a solo tabla performance? Is there a melodic instrument playing a repeating lehra/nagma? Can a 16-beat tintal cycle be counted? Is the tempo fast or slow? Are there tihai (three-fold cadential) endings?

l1b_rayatt.claim: Gurdain Rayatt, tintal tabla solo Dhir Dhir, Darbar Festival
l1b_rayatt.ask: Confirm: solo tabla with a melodic lehra? Is the tintal 16-beat cycle countable? Does the tempo increase? Are there clear sections (theka, kaida, tihai) and a clear sam?

l1c_tarikhan.claim: Ustad Tari Khan, Teen Taal tabla solo, Darbar Festival
l1c_tarikhan.ask: Confirm: solo tabla in teental with lehra accompaniment? Countable 16-beat cycle? Tempo? Any spoken introduction or applause?

l1d_dholexpress.claim: Kuljit Bhamra, The Dhol Express - bhangra dhol track
l1d_dholexpress.ask: Confirm: is the dhol (double-headed Punjabi barrel drum) audible? Is there a bhangra chaal groove with swung long-short quaver pairs? What other instruments (tumbi, vocals, synths, brass) are heard? Is there singing?

l1e_safri.claim: Balwinder Safri, Aaja Billo - UK bhangra track
l1e_safri.ask: Confirm: bhangra with dhol? Is the chaal rhythm audible? Are there Punjabi vocals (boliyan-style), tumbi, harmonium, or synths? Describe the production era.

l1f_bhamra91.claim: Kuljit Bhamra, Tabla and Dhol Bhangra Beat Solo, 1991, Keda Records
l1f_bhamra91.ask: Confirm: are dhol and tabla both heard? Is a bhangra chaal groove audible? Is there any melody or singing, or is it purely percussion?

l2a_samaibayati.claim: Classical Arabic Orchestra of Aleppo, Samai Bayati: oud taqsim then samai thaqil 10/8 then samai darij 6/8
l2a_samaibayati.ask: Confirm: is there a free-rhythm oud taqsim (improvisation) at the start? Do you hear qanun, ney, violin, riq or darabuka? Does a 10/8 rhythmic cycle begin, and later a faster 6/8? Are microtonal (quarter-tone) intervals audible? Is the texture heterophonic (all playing the same melody with slight differences)?

l2b_samaihusseini.claim: Classical Arabic Orchestra of Aleppo, Samai Husseini: samai thaqil 10/8 then samai darij 6/8
l2b_samaihusseini.ask: Confirm instruments (oud, qanun, ney, violin, riq/darabuka). Is a 10/8 cycle audible? Does it change to 6/8? Any taqsim? Microtones?

l2c_mesogios.claim: Orchestra Mesogios, Kalamatianos - Greek folk dance in 7/8
l2c_mesogios.ask: Confirm: is the metre 7/8 grouped 3+2+2? Which instruments are heard (clarinet, violin, bouzouki, laouto, santouri, tambourine)? Is it instrumental or sung? Does it speed up?

l2d_sgouros.claim: Nikos Sgouros, Kalamatianos Dance (Moreas) - Greek folk dance in 7/8
l2d_sgouros.ask: Confirm: is the metre 7/8 grouped 3+2+2? Which instruments? Instrumental or sung? Recording quality?

l3a_matadi.claim: Famoudou Konate with Ensemble Hamana Dan Ba, Matadi - Malinke drum ensemble from Guinea
l3a_matadi.ask: Confirm: is this a West African drum ensemble? Do you hear a bell (kenken/gankogui) timeline, dundun bass drums and djembes? Is there a lead/master drummer soloing over an ostinato? Is there call-and-response singing? Do parts enter one at a time?

l3b_agbekor.claim: Ewe Agbekor (slow), Ghanaian drum ensemble with gankogui bell
l3b_agbekor.ask: Confirm: bell timeline audible? Which drums? Call and response? Audio quality - is it a field/class recording or a produced recording?

l3c_sona.claim: Sona Jobarteh, Jarabi, kora performance filmed by BBC News Africa
l3c_sona.ask: Confirm: is the kora (21-string West African harp) clearly audible? Is there singing? What else is heard (guitar, balafon, percussion, bass)? Is there an introductory kumbengo pattern and improvised birimintingo flourishes? Any spoken introduction?

l3d_toumani.claim: Toumani Diabate, Djelika - solo or small-group kora
l3d_toumani.ask: Confirm: kora audible? Solo or with other instruments (balafon, ngoni, bass)? Is there a repeating accompaniment pattern with improvised runs above it? Any singing?

l4a_monobloco.claim: Monobloco, Peguei Um Ita No Norte live - Rio samba bateria
l4a_monobloco.ask: Confirm: is a full samba bateria heard? Do you hear surdo (deep drum), tamborim, agogo bells, repinique, caixa/snare, ganza shaker? Is the metre duple (2/4)? Is there a call (repinique) that starts the band? Are there sung verses and a chorus? Is there a break or paradinha?

l4b_allstars.claim: Trinidad All Stars Steel Orchestra, Curry Tabanca - Panorama calypso arrangement for steelband
l4b_allstars.ask: Confirm: steel pans clearly audible? Can you distinguish high (tenor) pans from low (bass) pans? Is there an engine room (irons/cowbell, scratcher, drum kit)? Is the metre duple with calypso syncopation? Are there distinct sections - introduction, verse, chorus, key change, ending? Any crowd noise or announcer?
